recs.x: Some technologies have been lost, even though they were superior to what is available today. Take, for example, the old “green/blue screen” technique using sodium vapor lamps, used by Walt Disney in film production in the pre-digital era: [link] (12 minutes long, but totally worth it).

recs.stt: The Walt Disney Company and OpenAI Partner on Sora
recs.x:
ely thought-provoking) video, I do think that the Marvel model of "pre-viz everything to death, the edit's already done before filming begins" - [link] - can lose a lot of spontaneity. Perhaps the fading luster to Marvel films overall will bring us back from this place.

On a more tangential note around green screens and their limitations when used ubiquitously, Corridor Digital's quasi-rediscovery of the Sodium Vapor process used by Disney through the early '80s, but lost to history ever since, is a fantastic watch. [link]
